# Contributing

Hey! Thanks for wanting to contribute to GitHub Dashboards 🎉

## Getting Started

Checkout the [README](https://github.com/Lissy93/github-dashboards?tab=readme-ov-file#developing) for setup instructions, it's all very standard (clone, install, copy the `.env`, start Postgres, push the schema and run).

## Code Style

Short, readable and DRY. Prettier and ESLint handle formatting, so just run `npm run format` before you commit.

Keep comments to a single short line saying what a block does, and reuse the existing utils and components before adding new ones.

## Before You Submit

Make sure all the checks pass, by running `npm run lint`, `npm run check` and `npm test`.

For all project commands, take a look at the [`package.json`](https://github.com/Lissy93/github-dashboards/blob/main/package.json).

When opening your PR, fill in the template so it gets labelled and lands in the right section of the release notes.

## Code of Conduct

Be respectful and constructive. See [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) for details.
